[[idris2-abi]]
== Idris2 ABI source policy

*`idris2-abi` · policy-gate · enforcing*

When abi.ipkg exists, scan selected ABI source paths for prohibited IO/unsafe patterns.

*Assurance boundary:* Source-pattern check only: this action does not run the Idris2 compiler or establish formal purity.

* link:../../actions/idris2-abi-check/action.yml[Action definition and inputs]

[[zig-unified-api-adapter]]
== Zig adapter source policy

*`zig-unified-api-adapter` · policy-gate · enforcing*

Scan Zig files for direct std.fs/std.io usage prohibited by estate adapter policy.

*Assurance boundary:* Pattern check, not a Zig compiler invocation or proof of adapter correctness.
